q.en: Arrange: (P) is reading (Q) the boy (R) a book
q.as: সজাওক: (P) is reading (Q) the boy (R) a book

explanation.en: The subject comes first, so the order is the boy, is reading, a book.
explanation.as: কৰ্তা প্ৰথমে আহে, গতিকে ক্ৰম the boy, is reading, a book।

q.en: Arrange: (P) in the garden (Q) the children (R) are playing
q.as: সজাওক: (P) in the garden (Q) the children (R) are playing

explanation.en: The subject and verb come first, then the place phrase.
explanation.as: কৰ্তা আৰু ক্ৰিয়া প্ৰথমে আহে, তাৰ পিছত স্থানৰ বাক্যাংশ।

q.en: Arrange: (P) because it was raining (Q) we stayed at home (R) all day
q.as: সজাওক: (P) because it was raining (Q) we stayed at home (R) all day

explanation.en: The main clause comes first and the reason follows.
explanation.as: মূল খণ্ডবাক্য প্ৰথমে আহে আৰু কাৰণ পিছত আহে।

q.en: Arrange: (P) is the capital (Q) Dispur (R) of Assam
q.as: সজাওক: (P) is the capital (Q) Dispur (R) of Assam

explanation.en: The subject Dispur comes first, then the verb phrase.
explanation.as: কৰ্তা Dispur প্ৰথমে আহে, তাৰ পিছত ক্ৰিয়া বাক্যাংশ।
